Register) paint the same form; from CB Settings a verified shop lands on Home. SET1: the same step and the shop's own particulars (GSTIN · address · state · PIN — what the invoice party reads) are CB Settings (settings.html), never the workshop. CS1: the constitution (country · currency · FY · tax registration) is set once; a country with no pack is said in the server's sentence. CL1 · CL2: the Country lab shows what REGISTERING in another country would look like, read from the packs — a shop never changes country once it has a product or a transaction (DECISIONS 13 Oct). CS2 (2026-10-13): the country may be CORRECTED until the shop holds a product or a transaction (api country-setup.isConstituted) — currency · FY · scheme · time zone · chart re-derived from the new pack in one transaction; after that Country and Money are greyed with the reason and the server refuses (409). The picker = the server's countries[] (the registered packs); a multi-zone pack asks the zone, the device's preselected. FX-AU1 (2026-10-14): registration STORES the guess the panel showed (country · money · zone, the server naming its source) in the write that creates the shop; an IN→AU correction re-lays the year by its dates and the chart shows only the new pack's ledgers. CL3: both screens show "Where ChitBridge is for <country>" — per product area ✅ · ⚠️ · ❌ · —, read from public/data/country-ready.json (scripts/country-ready.cjs: the engines' COUNTRY-MATRIX × COUNTRY-COVERAGE §1). GOV-SPIN (2026-10-14): a regional spin STATES its country (api installation.country, b382); the register panel offers it first ("This ChitBridge runs in Australia", the browser's differing guess beside it), shows what its pack applies (money · year · tax · format · language), and the one reg-agree accepts it; another country only inside the constitution's allowed.countries. registerNew stores the offer, verify the accepted country + its source (signup_context.country_source, b383). e2e/walk-spin-country.cjs walks installation × browser. |
